spans.s: केन [kēna], ind. By what ? whence, how, why; वत्सोपमन्यो केन वृत्तिं कल्पयसि
. केनेशितोपनिषद्, केनोपनिषद् N. of one of the old principal Upaniṣads.
केनती [kēnatī], The amorous sports of love.
केनिप [kēnipa], a. Ved. Wise, learned (मेधाविन्); यथा केनिपा- नामिनो वृधे
केनिपातः [kēnipātḥ], A rudder, helm, a large oar used as a rudder.
केन्दुः [kēnduḥ] न्दुकः [ndukḥ], न्दुकः N. of a tree (Mangosteen), a variety of ebony.
केन्द्रम् [kēndram], 1 The centre of a circle.
Distance of a planet from the first point of its orbit in the 4th, 7th or 1th degree.
The first, fourth, seventh and tenth lunar mansion.
